name: Precision Cables
old_description: Precision Cables uses all of the most modern technology in cable manufacturing to provide you the highest quality products in a short amount of time.
about:
Precision Cables operates from American Fork, Utah. The company was founded by Raymond Mulitalo and Mauro Carlini, who serve as co-owners, after they experienced recurrent quality issues with previous cable suppliers and identified a market gap for reliable, high-quality cable products.

The company manufactures custom and standardized cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and electromechanical box builds. Its services include cable assembly, harness routing and assembly, over molding, testing, consignment/turnkey supply, and mechanical box builds. The facility is equipped with formboards for 100% continuity testing, harness drawing software, mating harness test fixtures, in-line inkjet circuit printing, a woven nylon braiding machine, and a height and pull tester. No headcount or volume figures are disclosed.

Precision Cables serves automotive (including farming and mining), commercial (audio, instrumentation, electro-mechanical, Ethernet, Cat 5, data), law enforcement/military (drone, autonomous, safety systems), and industrial (oil, drone, aerospace) sectors.

The company emphasizes quality assurance through IPC/WHMA-A-620 trained personnel capable of class 2 and 3 workmanship, pursuit of ISO 9001:2015 registration, RoHS compliance, and a custom-solutions approach with engineering support. It also offers consignment and turnkey supply models to streamline customer operations.
